function_specs.name: _SemaphoreCreate
function_specs.meaning: Under the held os_inv, return -5 with unchanged state or publish a fresh semaphore with value val at the minimum free ID and restore the complete invariant.

function_specs.name: x_malloc
function_specs.meaning: Trusted allocation may fail; successful allocation returns aligned, bounded, privately owned bytes.

function_specs.name: memset
function_specs.meaning: Trusted byte initialization returns the original pointer and owns the full repeated-byte array.

function_specs.name: x_free
function_specs.meaning: Trusted reclamation consumes the complete private allocation.

function_specs.name: IdInsertObj
function_specs.meaning: Imported ID contract either leaves the manager unchanged with private node storage or links the node at a minimum free ID.

function_specs.name: InitDoubleLinkList
function_specs.meaning: Imported contract overwrites the two owned pointer fields with a self-linked node.

function_specs.name: DoubleLinkListInsertNodeAfter
function_specs.meaning: Imported polymorphic DLL contract inserts the new node at the specified valid anchor.
